quarterly_data.signal: CEO Anirudh Devgan sized the workload driver behind EDA and emulation demand off the foundry roadmap: 'If you look at TSMC roadmap, next five years, they said that chips complexity or size will go up by 48x.' He added that customers tell him that at that pace 'every year, if they continue like this, they need to hire 2x more engineers. It's not sustainable', so a 5 to 10x automation step is required just to sustain the roadmap, and that the IMEC roadmap projects this exponential to run until 2042.
quarterly_data.figure: chip complexity/size up 48x over the next five years (TSMC roadmap); customers would otherwise need 2x more engineers every year; exponential projected to 2042

quarterly_data.signal: HARDWARE (PALLADIUM EMULATION) DEMAND AT A RECORD AND CADENCE FABS ITS OWN EMULATION SILICON AT TSMC: Devgan said hardware acceleration 'can run things like 1,000 times faster' and that 'we are the only company that designs our own chip actually at TSMC. If you look at our hardware system, these are as complex as the latest GPU or XPU system. These are liquid cooled, fully optically connected racks', with a '10, 15-year lead in designing our own.' He said demand is rising because the amount of hardware bought is proportional to chip size, and that it 'has been record year for, I do not know, last 6 years. I do not think that is going to slow down.'
quarterly_data.figure: emulation runs ~1,000 times faster than CPUs; 10, 15-year design lead; record hardware year for the last 6 years

quarterly_data.signal: PHYSICAL AI IS THE NEXT VERTICAL SLICE AFTER DATA CENTER, BOUGHT VIA HEXAGON: Devgan said 'Physical AI, we did acquisition in Hexagon to get the best middle layer for that. It is the best robotic simulator', because the top layer for physical AI is a world model rather than an LLM and 'There is no data for the world model. You have to do a lot more simulation.' He said data center is the slice at peak now while 'physical AI may peak in next 3 to 7 years' and sciences AI 5 to 10 years out, and that physical AI will pull more mixed-signal silicon - naming Tesla, Rivian, BYD, Xiaomi and NIO as chip-designing Cadence customers ('They are all designing chips. They are all our customers').
quarterly_data.figure: physical AI expected to peak in next 3 to 7 years; life sciences 5 to 10 years out
